title: Subarray Sums Divisible by K

monster.name: Ring Divisor Demon
monster.title: Harvester of Exact Modular Cycles
monster.defeatQuote: Combinations of identical remainders summed up all divisible subarrays!

description: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the number of non-empty subarrays that have a sum divisible by `k`.
starterCode:
def subarraysDivByK(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def subarraysDivByK(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    from collections import defaultdict
    count = defaultdict(int)
    count[0] = 1
    curr = 0
    ans = 0
    for n in nums:
        curr = (curr + n) % k
        ans += count[curr]
        count[curr] += 1
    return ans
